description: Abstract class BodyDTO for serializing and deserializing different Body types in MockServer, including methods for creating DTOs from Body objects, converting DTOs to strings, and managing optionality.

classes.name: BodyDTO
classes.description: Abstract Data Transfer Object class for various Body types used in MockServer serialization.

methods.name: createDTO
methods.description: Factory method to create specific BodyDTO instances based on the runtime type of the Body object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a BodyDTO instance into its string representation, handling different Body types.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the Body.

methods.name: getOptional
methods.description: Returns whether the Body is optional.

methods.name: withOptional
methods.description: Sets the optional flag for the BodyDTO.

methods.name: buildObject
methods.description: Abstract method to build a Body object from the DTO.
